title.zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
title.en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack

current_state.zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
current_state.en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.

updates.title_zh: 加密硬件钱包遭攻击，估计损失7000万美元
updates.title_en: Crypto Hardware Wallets Hit in Estimated $70 Million Attack
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger报告称，加密货币硬件钱包在一场估计损失7000万美元的攻击中被盗空，引发了对自托管设备安全保证的担忧。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger reported that cryptocurrency hardware wallets were drained in an attack estimated at $70 million, raising concerns about the security guarantees of self-custody devices.

updates.title_zh: 加密用户能信任硬件钱包背后的供应链吗？
updates.title_en: Can crypto users trust the supply chain behind hardware wallets?
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 确认通过授权经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的一台受影响设备含有未授权植入模块；这些恶意植入模块会截取用户助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输。Trezor 也宣布作为预防措施减少经销商数量。
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger confirmed that one affected device sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis contained an unauthorized implant; the malicious implants captured users’ recovery phrases and transmitted them over cellular networks. Trezor also announced it would reduce resellers as a preventive step.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包被盗事件现已确认涉及供应链环节：授权经销商售出的设备被植入未授权模块，助记词可被截获并外传；行业对硬件钱包供应链与自托管安全保证的审查加剧。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet loss incident is now confirmed to involve the supply chain: devices sold through an authorized reseller contained unauthorized implants that could capture and exfiltrate recovery phrases, intensifying scrutiny of hardware-wallet supply-chain and self-custody security guarantees.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A Cointelegraph report, featuring hardware-security researcher Joe Grand, examines whether crypto users can realistically verify the integrity of hardware wallets after reported losses involving Ledger devices sold through authorized reseller CryptoBilis.
